summary: The diff implements the majority of all 8 requirements. Backend messaging, follow, and notification systems are present in main.mo. Frontend pages (MessagesPage, MessageThreadPage, NotificationsPanel, PostPickerModal) are added. Routes, BottomNav, TopBar, ProfilePage, and UserProfilePage are updated. A few specific acceptance criteria have gaps or partial implementations worth noting.

missing_requirements.requirement: Navigating to /messages while unauthenticated shows a login prompt (REQ-7 AC)
missing_requirements.reason: The routeTree.ts registers the /messages route without any auth guard, and the truncated MessagesPage does not clearly show a login-prompt for unauthenticated users.

missing_requirements.requirement: Unread message count badge shown on the Messages nav icon (REQ-4 / REQ-7 AC)
missing_requirements.reason: BottomNav.tsx explicitly hard-codes the unread count return as 0 ('return count > 0 ? 0 : 0') and the badge only indicates presence of any conversation rather than a true unread count. The real per-message unread count is not propagated to the nav icon badge.

missing_requirements.requirement: Unauthenticated users see the Shadows count but cannot follow without logging in — show login prompt (REQ-5 AC)
missing_requirements.reason: UserProfilePage.tsx is truncated and it is unclear whether unauthenticated visitors see the Shadows count and a login prompt instead of the Follow button.

hallucinated_features.description: A backend/migration.mo file is added with a no-op migration where NewActor is identical to OldActor and the run function simply returns the old state unchanged.
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request did not ask for a migration module. The new stable variables for messages, follows, and notifications are defined as let bindings in main.mo rather than being represented in the migration types, making this file unrequested extra scaffolding.
